name: antigravity-admin-terminal
description: Execute Windows commands with Administrator privileges via gsudo and native UAC confirmation while keeping normal Antigravity sandboxing intact.
author: icywhite22 & Gemini
suggestedPrompts: Check admin_terminal_status to see whether UAC elevation is ready
Run an elevated command via run_admin_command with UAC confirmation
Revoke active gsudo elevated credential cache with revoke_admin_cache
